**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

It is a great relief to-day to hear of the operation being over.[^1] I am so glad [Dr.

Moberly](../persons.html#1015) was able to be there. I have been wishing to see [Mr.

Keble](../persons.html#798) to hear how [you](../persons.html#1025) were all looking in Oxford, but we have not been able to go to Hursley. [Johnnie](../persons.html#1017)'s wig is very shaggy, but we agree that he is growing very handsome. . . .

[^1]: The operation on [George Moberly](../persons.html#1014) the younger.
